description.narrative: Lok IV, managed by Lok Investment Management Limited, is a $150 million to $180 million SME-focused fund which will invest in financial services businesses and technology-enabled business models in agriculture, healthcare and climate. The fund aims to support inclusive and sustainable growth in India by catering to lower-income and underserved communities.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We have committed a total of $15 million to Lok Capital Fund IV (Lok IV), managed by Lok Investment Management Limited (an initial investment of $5 million in 2022, followed by a top up of $10 million in 2023). Lok IV aims to invest in early and growth-stage companies in financial services (including fintech) and tech-enabled businesses in agriculture, healthcare and climate. The objective of the fund is to promote access, quality, and affordability of services in India, predominantly in Tier 2 and 3 towns, rural areas and states with low per capital income. The fund is also 2X-qualified.
